title: Wildfire evacuation order, warning, shelter in place, all clear and re-entry notice
description: A zone-based notice from a sheriff or emergency management agency: the action, then every zone with its status word (Evacuation order, Evacuation warning, Shelter in place, All clear, Re-entry open or No status), the area in words, the time of the status and the number of residents, with routes, shelters and help to leave. Zone ids and status words must match the zone map and every other message. The variant sets the title (order, warning, shelter in place, all clear or re-entry).

agency.description: Issuing agency (sheriff, police or emergency management; fictional).

issuedAt.description: Issue time, local, with the time zone.

headline.description: One-line headline that names the action and the zones.
examples: Evacuation order for Zones C-1, C-2 and C-3: leave now

zones.description: Every zone named in this notice, one row each. Zone ids are written exactly as on the zone map and the same in every message.

zone.description: Zone id exactly as on the map.

area.description: The area in words: neighborhoods, roads or landmarks.
examples: Pine Hollow and Upper Mill Road

status.description: Status of the zone, always one of these words.

since.description: When the zone took this status.

notes.description: Special populations, sweeps or access notes.
examples: Mill Creek Care Home is being moved by ambulance bus.

action.description: What people in the zones should do now, in order.
examples: Leave now. Take people, pets and medications. Do not wait for a second notice.
Use Canyon Road south to Highway 9. Contraflow is not in effect.
People: Calloway High School gym (open). Large animals: County Fairgrounds, Gate B.

accessNeeds.description: How people who need help to leave can get it.
examples: Call 555-0170 for a ride; deputies are checking known addresses.

definitions.description: The project's own definition of the status words, since terms vary by place.
examples: In Calloway County an evacuation order means leave immediately; an evacuation warning means be ready to leave.

reentryRules.description: For re-entry or all clear: who may return, when and under what conditions.
examples: Residents with ID may return to Zone C-1 after 8 AM; utilities may be off.

nextUpdate.description: When the next update is expected.
